rules.cc_premium_net: STO credit notionals minus BTC debit notionals minus option fees on covered_call fills
rules.capital_deployed: Sum of open equity deployed_usd (cost). Not portfolio.equity_value.
rules.week_return_vs_budget: Combined week total / sleeve_budget_usd, stored as week_return_pct_vs_program and income.roc_vs_budget
rules.refresh: Twice daily: get_portfolio writes portfolio.total_value and portfolio.cash; roll fills into income, weeks, weekly_summary, and cc_trades. Leave dividends and scalps empty until Robinhood activity has them.
rules.realized_equity_pnl: Stock exits (not CC/dividend/scalp/assignment) are tracked in realized_trades[] and income.realized_equity_pnl / weeks[].realized_equity_pnl; they are NOT folded into combined_income or total_week_pnl.
